name: Dash
title: Sprint Cat
description: Finishes the sprint before planning ends.
catchphrase: Finishes the sprint before planning ends.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Tender steak bite! Yellow cheetah coat crackles with speed! 🥩🐆
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Paws already blurring in a sprint before the morning standup starts! 🐆
companionPersonality.petReaction: Dashes around your chair at Mach 2, then gives warm nose nuzzles! 🐆💖

dialogue.idle: Stretching long athletic legs, pacing impatiently for work. 🐆
dialogue.working: Blazing through the entire sprint backlog before lunch break! 🐆⚡
dialogue.thinking: Calculating the fastest line through the sprint tasks... 🤔
dialogue.success: SPRINT FINISHED! All tickets in the Done column at record speed! 🐆🎉
dialogue.error: Overshot the finish line! Drifting round the corner to retry! 🐆
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping stretched out long and sleek on the sofa... 🌙
